description: This file implements credential management functionalities for a version control system, including credential initialization, clearing, matching, formatting, reading, writing, and interaction with external credential helpers.

methods.name: void credential_init(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Initializes a credential structure by setting all fields to default/empty values.

methods.name: void credential_clear(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Clears and resets all sensitive information in a credential structure, including secrets and allocated strings.

methods.name: void credential_next_state(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Prepares the credential structure for the next state in a multi-stage process by swapping header vectors.

methods.name: void credential_clear_secrets(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Frees and nulls out secret fields (password, credential) in the credential structure.

methods.name: void credential_set_capability(struct credential_capability * capa,enum credential_op_type op_type)
methods.description: Sets specific capability bits in a credential_capability structure based on the operation type.

methods.name: void credential_set_all_capabilities(struct credential * c,enum credential_op_type op_type)
methods.description: Enables all capabilities for a credential to handle a specific credential operation type.

methods.name: void credential_announce_capabilities(struct credential * c,FILE * fp)
methods.description: Announces the capabilities supported by the credential, writing them to a file.

methods.name: int credential_match(const struct credential * want,const struct credential * have,int match_password)
methods.description: Checks whether the given credential matches another credential based on credentials’ fields.

methods.name: int credential_config_callback(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx UNUSED,void * data)
methods.description: Handles setting credential configuration options based on project config variables.

methods.name: void credential_describe(struct credential * c,struct strbuf * out)
methods.description: Produces a human-readable description of the credential URL.

methods.name: void credential_format(struct credential * c,struct strbuf * out)
methods.description: Serializes the credential into a URL-like string format.

methods.name: char * credential_ask_one(const char * what,struct credential * c,int flags)
methods.description: Prompts the user for a credential component (e.g., username, password) with an optional description.

methods.name: int credential_getpass(struct repository * r,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Retrieves password credentials interactively with the repository, considering configuration settings.

methods.name: int credential_has_capability(const struct credential_capability * capa,enum credential_op_type op_type)
methods.description: Checks whether a credential supports a particular operation capability based on its capability structure.

methods.name: int credential_read(struct credential * c,FILE * fp,enum credential_op_type op_type)
methods.description: Reads credential data from a file into a credential structure, parsing key-value pairs.

methods.name: void credential_write(const struct credential * c,FILE * fp,enum credential_op_type op_type)
methods.description: Writes the credential data to a file, including capabilities and secrets as appropriate.

methods.name: void credential_fill(struct repository * r,struct credential * c,int all_capabilities)
methods.description: Fills in missing credential fields by applying configuration, helpers, and user interaction.

methods.name: void credential_approve(struct repository * r,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Stores the credential using helper programs after successful validation.

methods.name: void credential_reject(struct repository * r,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Rejects/forgets the credential, deleting stored secrets and resetting states.

methods.name: void credential_from_url(struct credential * c,const char * url)
methods.description: Parses a full URL string into the credential structure, populating host, protocol, user, path, etc.
